topic: The automatic app-open during work sessions
body:
**You sat down to do real work. Eight minutes later you were on Instagram. You did not decide to go there.**

There was a moment of mild friction in the task — a sentence that was not forming, a decision that required thought — and your hand moved before your brain caught up.

This is not weakness. This is an extremely well-trained escape route. Every time work got hard and the phone provided relief, that escape route got reinforced. You practised it hundreds of times. It is now faster than conscious thought.

The research on this is clear. After a phone interruption — even one you initiated — it takes an average of 23 minutes to return to full task engagement. And most people get interrupted again before they get back.

So eight minutes of work, 23 minutes of recovery, another interruption. That is the actual output structure of most people's days.

The intervention is environmental. Phone goes in a different room during work blocks. Not on silent. Not face-down. A different room. Out of reach means out of the reflex chain entirely.

One room change. Measurable difference. Start there.

Full protocol is in the link in bio.
